name: blink2talk
description: Blink2Talk patient screen, as a full-screen desktop app

scripts.eyes: cd ../vision && npx --no-install rolldown src/cv/index.ts -f esm -p browser -o ../app/renderer/vendor/eyes.js && node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs ../app/renderer
scripts.prestart: npm run eyes || echo 'Eye tracking not built (run npm install --legacy-peer-deps in ../vision). Keyboard only.'; npm run voices || echo 'Speaker-recognition model not downloaded; voices will not be told apart.'
